eps.ov: An ancient king is reincarnated countless years after his death so that he can truly master the blade.
Inglis comes to learn more about the strange world around her, and how it differs from her own time.
Inglis leaves her home and sets out for the capital to begin the next stage of her life.

eps.t: The Town Ruled by the Highlander
eps.ov: Inglis makes a new friend after a complex battle involving the leader of the Bloodchain Brigade.
Inglis begins her new life at the Knights' Academy.
The party is selected to take a special test that will push them to their mental limits.
Ripple is very sick, and it looks like the Highland is responsible...
The students of the academy set up teams to protect Ripple from the magicite beasts she's unwittingly summoning.
Rani gets a powerful new artifact with a unique ability.

eps.t: The Plan to Attack a Highlander
eps.ov: A new Highlander emissary comes, and the Bloodchain Brigade wants him dead.
The plan to save Ripple proceeds as Inglis meets a powerful foe.

eps.t: Clash! Hero-King vs. King of Rainbows
eps.ov: A Prisma has materialized, and now it's up to everyone to join forces to defeat it before it destroys everything in its path.
